// REQ: LANG-891 LANG-892 LANG-893 LANG-894
use fmt;
use strings;

type point = struct {
	x: int,
	y: f64,
};

fn square(x: int) int = x * x;

@test fn square_test() void = {
	assert(square(3) == 9);
};

export fn main() void = {
	const name = "world";
	const raw = `C:\temp\file`;
	let c: rune = 'x';
	let count: size = 0x1F + 1000;
	for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
		if (i > 0 && c != '\n') {
			fmt::printfln("Hello, {}! {}", name, square(i))!;
		};
	};
	let p: nullable *point = null;
	defer free(p);
};
